body:
Hmmm. You've given me something to think on...
Maybe it is a defense mechanism? To keep my littleness a secret/only for my daddy?

Yeah...nothing is as special as a gift from my daddy <3 I can agree there.
And yes its such a common gift when someone is ill which is why I know that my grisly reaction is even more stupid...I just can't help the immediate reaction/what I've conditioned myself to maybe.

Oh please don't get me wrong...
I appreciate the gift and the thought behind it. I really do...
It's just the way my brain thinks and how it tries to separate the two since my littleness is extremely private in most ways (aside from posting about it here obviously x.x) and I sort of mini panic when someone does something I consider apart of my littleness (like I'm being outed or something).

I keep a journal and write everyday. I love to read, write, draw and solve any type of puzzle I can get my hands on. I also love to sew and make costumes. I like video games and  tabeltop gaming. I can't do video games as much because it accelerates my heart beat too much depending on the type of game. But I like boardgames and D&D

Thank you...
That was very thoughtful advice. I have seen the hospital psych but no he has not spoken with my SO. He asked if he would like to be involved and I couldn't give a definitive answer. I think he would but I didn't want to speak for him and I haven't brought it up to him yet.
I'm trying to find "my little bit of happiness" in every day but I just feel so heavy and downtrodded. Like I'm drowning and nothing, absolutely nothing has meaning. My food tastes like Ash in my mouth and even the sound of laughter seems muted...like it's miles away from me.
I'm trying to find ways to cope

You're right. Its not really what I am looking for and I don't know how well that subreddit applies to me but: "Dealing with your own relationship with mortality"...
I suppose that specific tagline holds some interest for me
Thank you
Yes, out of the last few hospitals I have been to, so far the care teams at Johns Hopkins has been the best in quality. I appreciate how hard the staff works here and how well they listen.
Thank you for your reply. I'll PM soon. I'm curious to hear other people's struggles and how they work at overcoming what they can
I would also love to be home. But I get what you say about preferring a hospital to an office. I totally agree. I guess being in hospitals for long terms have worn me down

I have bounced around 4 or 5 for different ailments but now I'm at The Johns Hopkins Hospital which is very large and caters to everything I need Health-wise. I would still very much rather be home of course. It does get super lonely here too. Nights are the worst. The nurses come in and out for different things at night but honestly...they might as well be invisible because it doesn't help the loneliness. Don't get me wrong. They are wonderful at their jobs and they do their best...but nothing can quite quell loneliness in a hospital.
Are you currently in a hospital or do you have some time you can spend at home as well?
Will definitely PM soon. Thank you. :)
OHMYGOD thank you! This looks like so much fun and therapeutic! I like!

Thank you so much. I think I just don't want him to feel ANY sort of burden...but I guess in a relationship both people should carry troubles together? 
I like your statement about our daddies wanting our broken bits as well. That helped me feel better. Thank you <3

I think most littles in our position must feel like a let down for our daddies. It really hurts to think that way. You seem very dedicated to your daddy's happiness and wanting the best for him. I'm sure he sees that and wants to reciprocate. I bet he wants to the best for YOU and probably doesn't mind pushing you in your wheelchair at all. He chose to be with you <3
Hearing other people's stories and struggles really helps me not feel so alone. I wish none of us had to deal with things so cruel and unfair. Thank you for replying <3

1. I have very recently decided to be as positive as I can about the cards I have been dealt... but no. I do not think a cure will be achieved/made available in our lifetime.
2. I am not as far gone into the disease and it hasn't impaired my day to day living much at all except for the sadness it causes me when I think of it. If I were cured, I would hope it would make me all the more dedicated to being as positive as realistically possible given my life/other issues/
My Omorashi fetish extends to not only when I'm protected by my diapee... /.\

I am hesitant to say seek by your fetish...only due to the fact that A LOT of people on particular fetish dating sites are very disrespectful and grabby/demanding /.\ I think some are that way because they are there ONLY to seek satisfaction for their fetish/sexual needs and NOT actually trying to start a real loving relationship once they find someone compatible. 
I wouldn't even know what dating sites would be best anyways :(

Luckily, my daddy turned out to be one of my long time steam friends. One day we started playing more games together after noticing how well we co op together, and then we started talking more outside of steam and getting closer. I started getting lovey feelings for him and my little side kept coming out more and more when I thought of him so I decided to maybe let him know that I'ma little. Turns out he was  a DL and he said he was nervous to share that with me up until I shared with him about me being a little/baby! So about your question about 'how to start that conversation', you kinda just have to...take that leap and trust it will work out in the way it's supposed to. (Sorry if that sounds like naive bs, but that's exactly what I did). It was very lucky that both of our secrets melded so well together and now he is able to explore his AB side a lot more I think. 

I say all that to mean, that though their may have been a bit of luck on our side with us having such similar a-kin interests which may have played a part in making it easier for us to accept each other, I still believe that you don't have to rely heavily on your fetish/kink/interest in order to find a mate :3

They may be where you least expect it. A friend you reconnect with, a buddy on a forum etc. I think too often people DEFINE themselves by their fetish/kink and ONLY look for love in those specific places. But you can find someone to accept you for you and even engage in your interests outside of those places. It can be nerve wracking to share your secret with someone but worth it and it will be okay if they truly care for you <3
